 Conroe High Lockdown- CSO and CISD PD on Scene- No Injuries
 By: Montgomery County Sheriff's Office | Published 11/19/2026
 My Favorites 
 Share 
 Tweet 
 Linkedin 
 CONROE, TX -- The Montgomery County Sheriff’s Office is on scene at Conroe High School, assisting CISD Police and other responding agencies in securing the campus. The school is currently on lockdown. No injuries have been reported at this time.
